detail.longDescription: VictoriaMetrics was at P99! The event for developers who care about high-performance, low-latency applications. 🚀 Our Co-Founder, Roman Khavronenko, presented, "Writing a TSDB from Scratch: Performance Optimization." Application Performance # Monitoring and # Kubernetes monitoring in their current state are pretty expensive. The average VictoriaMetrics installation processes 2-4 million samples/s on the ingestion path and 20-40 million samples/s on the read path.
